title: A structured patch of one code package (zodchi flow code-package v1)

status.description: done: the changes do the task; blocked: the task cannot be done from what the request holds (say why in summary and questions)

summary.description: What the changes do and why, in a few sentences

changes.description: Every file change, each path once. Empty when nothing needs to change (a finding answered instead of fixed)

path.description: Path relative to the repository root, with forward slashes; for rename the new path

from.description: rename: the old path; null otherwise

baseBlob.description: The blob id the request gave for the file this change was written against (modify, delete, rename: of the old path); null for create

content.description: create and modify: the whole new content of the file; rename: the whole new content, or null to keep it; delete: null

unverified.description: What you could not be sure of from the request alone

questions.description: Open questions for the lead, each one line: the question, its options and your recommendation
